summary: Careful, reproducible preregistered paired study with full artifacts that executed as planned but yielded a null effect because the preregistered shared_initial_candidate design produced validator‑valid initial candidates for all tasks. Execution, analysis, and disclosure largely satisfy the run requirements; manuscript must make three limited clarifications/format fixes before finalisation.
required_revisions: Ensure the References section is a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) for each cited work rather than bare DOI/arXiv/identifier-only entries; update in-text citations to IEEE numeric markers and verify each cited record explicitly supports the adjacent claim (use the archived BibTeX to produce complete entries).

Condense and tighten the mandatory Disclosure Statement so it remains fully compliant but concise: remove provenance-level execution logs and duplicate artifact accounting from the Disclosure prose while preserving (exactly) the single required immutable master-prompt locator and its SHA‑256 digest and the concise summary of autonomy boundary, model(s), adapter, generation semantics (shared_initial_candidate), and the fact that temperature was null/unset.

Add one explicit, prominent sentence in the Abstract and one in the end of Introduction (or Methods) clearly stating that, because the preregistered design used shared_initial_candidate semantics (one sampled initial generation per intent reused for both arms), the confirmatory estimand measures only the downstream validator/repair effect on a fixed initial candidate and does NOT measure effects that would arise from independent per-condition first‑pass sampling or prompting strategies. This clarification must appear in the Abstract and next to the preregistration/design description.
optional_revisions: Add a brief, labeled Future‑Work paragraph suggesting specific follow‑on confirmatory contrasts that would test independent sampling (independent per-condition generation, higher-temperature sampling, or multiple-sample selection) and state which archived artifacts would be reused for those contrasts (no new experimental runs are requested here).

In Results or an Appendix, include two or three representative validator traces and the matching shared_initial_provider_trace excerpts (already present in artifacts) as compact examples to illustrate why no repairs were triggered; ensure these excerpts are short and do not replicate full execution logs so the Disclosure remains concise.
